structure.diagramNote: Simplified. ENEC Consulting ownership is not confirmed in public sources.
structure.diagramAlt: ADQ owns 100% of ENEC. ENEC owns 82% of ENEC Operations and of ENEC Commercial; KEPCO owns 18% of each. ENEC Consulting is an ENEC subsidiary.

enec.name: ENEC
enec.role: Owner and developer of Barakah; investment arm; leads international partnerships. Established December 2009.

enec-ops.name: ENEC Operations
enec-ops.role: Operates and maintains Barakah Units 1-4 and holds the four FANR operating licences. Still registered and licensed as Nawah.

enec-com.name: ENEC Commercial
enec-com.role: Holds project finance, the 60-year power purchase agreement with EWEC and the DoE generation licence.

enec-con.name: ENEC Consulting
enec-con.role: Advisory arm for countries starting nuclear programmes, launched 15 January 2025.

structure.oversightIntro: Kafa'a is not a regulatory channel. Regulators appear only as sources and, where ENEC chooses, as observers of aggregate reports.

ncema.body: National emergency authority for off-site planning; supervises national Barakah exercises.

honest.title: How the skills data is kept honest
honest.intro: The future-skills pages follow published international benchmarks, let evidence age, keep every change on record and label anything simulated.
honest.bmBody: Each feature names the international benchmarks it follows. Every benchmark is stored with its owner, its sources and the date they were read; select one to see them.
honest.decayBody: Every skill has a decay class. When your newest evidence for a level passes the half-life of its class, it counts one level lower until it is refreshed. Skill definitions are reviewed on a cycle of their own.
honest.decayCaption: Decay classes, evidence half-lives and review cycles
honest.lifeBody: Each skill shows whether demand for it is emerging, growing, stable or declining. Obsolete skills are kept and marked, never deleted, and every published change goes into the change log.
honest.simBody: Kafa'a is a concept within ENEC NEXUS, not an official ENEC website. The people and records you see are synthetic demo data, and figures marked "Simulated" or "Sample data" are illustrative, never presented as real. Official information is on enec.ae.
honest.authBody: Kafa'a records never change a licence or a qualification record; qualification entries only mirror the licensee's records as qualified or not qualified.
